pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with sharp edge transitions. Patches on the flank are expansive with high spatial area relative to the interstitial spaces, while neck patches are smaller and more elongated.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light buff-colored pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly Y-shaped intersections. The pathways maintain a thin, relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck. The mane presents a jagged 1D geometric contour against the hazy background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small reddish-brown avian organism is located on the mid-lateral flank, creating a localized pixel-level obstruction of the pelage pattern.
